scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: Kabir tells Meera he shared a pretend login code during practice. He worries that admitting the mistake will invite laughter. Meera listens calmly and says they should ask the teacher for help before sending anything else.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A useful response starts by limiting further exposure and getting support. Blame can make someone hide the event, which delays help. The class records the time, type of request and what category of information was shared, without writing the actual secret into a new notebook.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The teacher helps use known official account settings or support. Students do not negotiate with the sender or pay someone who promises a guaranteed recovery. Outcomes cannot be promised, but prompt honest reporting gives a trusted adult a better chance to take the appropriate next steps.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: Kabir is worried and has stopped sharing. A trusted teacher is available to help with the fictional account incident. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Thank you for telling me; let us get trusted help now. A calm response encourages reporting and keeps attention on stopping further harm instead of blaming the learner.
scenes.speech: Thank you for telling me; let us get trusted help now. A calm response encourages reporting and keeps attention on stopping further harm instead of blaming the learner.
scenes.dialogue: Record useful facts without copying secret values.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through stop further exposure, then a useful incident note, then support without blame. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
